scope: Independently inspected authored static six-view vehicle concept proposal only
method: Actual full-sheet image viewing; meaningful detail crops as enumerated. No generated score or claimed pixel-similarity measurement.
stronger_reference_gate: Not a final reference-sensitive asset/integration approval. Existing >=9.9 and exact-10 production requirements remain active.
untested: Native editable mesh and full 360 geometry
Full tool motion cycles and load/contact transitions
Driving, fuel use, resource custody, combat, audio and device performance
observations: All six named views are present, legible and uncropped. Two continuous tracks, single hydraulic breaker rather than spinning drill, ore hopper, desert ledge and planted working chisel are visible.
Working tracks and the two visible deployed feet contact stable ledge ground. The operating tool touches one boulder with a small amount of chips, without a fantasy explosion.

defects.location: AT WORK versus THREE-QUARTER and both profiles
defects.finding: The working panel places the ore hopper at the left end while the cab windshield/front bumper still face lower-left. In the studio views the hopper is behind the cab at the opposite end. The cab/hopper/boom relationship changes instead of only the boom pose.
defects.repair: Base the work-panel chassis, cab and hopper on THREE-QUARTER without relocating them. Extend the same boom toward the vehicle front onto a boulder; keep load hopper at the rear, and deploy the specified stabilizers.

defects.finding: The FRONT cab is at viewer-left, which is vehicle-right. The authored description specifies front-left.
defects.repair: Either render the intended handedness consistently or explicitly record an authored front-right adaptation; the owner did not require a particular side.

defects.location: Both travel profiles versus AT WORK
defects.finding: Each visible travel-side track carries two orange foot-like mounts at its fore/aft ends; AT WORK shows two lowered feet at the front corners. The authored description says two lateral stabilizer feet total, making their count and identity unclear.
defects.repair: Show one defined stabilizer per side in consistent mount positions, or explicitly define a four-leg authored variant and show the required deployed feet.
